title: Most common with deterministic ties
hints: Counter(items) counts everything; .items() gives (item, count) pairs you can sort yourself instead of trusting most_common's tie order.
sorted(pairs, key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0])) sorts by count descending then name ascending.
For include_ties take the count of the n-th entry (index n-1) and keep extending the slice while the next entry has that same count.
